messages:
tara: quick sync — a customer asked for a downloadable 'who changed what' export for compliance. we need to decide link format, access controls, retention, and console UX. who should be able to generate vs download?
kevin: presigned S3 urls are simplest but risky if they leak. we do presigned already for backups. we need scopes and TTL. also logging of the download event.
sasha: from console POV i want a single "generate export" modal that shows recipients, TTL, and a "contains PII" checkbox that forces extra justification. prefer email+console delivery rather than just a raw link.
oliver: security: signed URL + one-time download token + optional IP restriction. also require audit record: actor id, export id, timestamp, ip, user-agent. include HMAC manifest inside the bundle.
compliance-bot: exports with PII must be flagged and auto-deleted after retention window or moved to long-term encrypted storage with access approvals. see policy CN-401.
tara: telemetry note — we need route/model tags so we can attribute who exported during canary vs control. and make exports consume quota units (we bill for exports as big downloads).
kevin: backend sketch: POST /audit/exports {scope, format, recipients, ttl, require_approval} -> returns {job_id, status}. For small exports we can return immediate signed_url; for large ones run async and send webhook to tenant callback or email when ready. sample immediate response:```json
{"export_id":"exp_01","signed_url":"https://s3.aws/redwood/exp_01?X-Amz-...","expires_in":3600}
```
sasha: UX details: prefill "allowed users" with org-admins + specific collaborators. show explicit choices: "link access (anyone with link)" vs "tenant-authenticated users only". surface who approved (if approval required). show size estimate and expected ready time.
oliver: we should gate by feature-flag and require that generating admin confirms they have right to export. add a "consent and justification" freeform field that becomes part of the audit record.
tara: edge case: support often needs to inspect exports during investigations. propose "support export request" flow: support creates request which notifies owners; owner can approve and we log the approval; optional time-limited special link for support engineers.
kevin: implementation: SupportExportRequest resource with status {requested, approved, denied, expired}, auto-expire after 72h. when approved we issue a one-time token and increment tenant's export quota.
sasha: console list: show last 10 exports with columns: export_id, generator, created_at, status, size, retention_expires_at, download (arrow) disabled when expired, revoke button, and a tiny details panel with manifest.
oliver: export contents must include manifest.json with hashes for files and HMAC signature; validateable by customer if needed. also ensure server-side redaction options exist: pii_redaction: [none, mask, redact] and add a CI check for redaction regressions.
tara: ok i'm going to draft an RFC that includes API shapes, UX mocks, telemetry tags, quotas impact, and a privacy checklist. who wants to co-author? @kevin @sasha @oliver
kevin: i'll take the backend flow, quota burn, and webhook delivery details.
sasha: i'll do the mock screenshots and wording for the modal.
oliver: i'll add the security checklist, HMAC manifest, and IP restriction options.
compliance-bot: created ticket CN-1731 and assigned to tara, kevin, sasha, oliver. :white_check_mark:
